title: Remove dynamic metadata from committed grounding docs
context: The Hunch MCP server and the in-tree CLI generator were producing different outputs for the same documentation files. Specifically, decision/bug/constraint counts were present in files generated by the MCP server but absent from the in-tree CLI output. This created ongoing drift between what was committed and what the canonical generator produced, a grounding problem that recurred across multiple capture sessions.
decision: Remove all dynamic metadata counts (decisions, bugs, constraints, components, policies, open findings) from the documentation boilerplate in .cursor/rules/hunch.mdc, .github/copilot-instructions.md, .windsurf/rules/hunch.md, AGENTS.md, and CLAUDE.md. These counts are now generated only at runtime by the MCP tools, not embedded in committed docs.
consequences: Committed documentation no longer drifts from in-tree generator output
The MCP server and in-tree CLI now converge on the same document state
Reduces friction when capturing decision lineage across multiple sessions
Counts remain available dynamically via the hunch_* MCP tools rather than being stale in docs
alternatives_rejected: Keep counts committed and manually sync them with each capture (error-prone, doesn't scale)
Force MCP server output to match CLI exactly (may not be feasible if tools diverge)
Regenerate all docs on every commit hook (prevents manual additions and editorial control)
